# CG-REQ-029: Request property disallowed

A property old requests could send is now rejected.

**Why it matters:** A closed schema rejects undefined properties.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.propertyRemoved`, `schema.additionalPropertiesChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {what} is no longer allowed in {where}.
>
> Consumers that send it will be rejected by a provider that enforces the candidate schema.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the property defined (and ignore it), or keep the schema open.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: closed schema drops nickname

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, additionalProperties: false, properties: {a: {}, nickname: {}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, additionalProperties: false, properties: {a: {}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Property "nickname" is no longer allowed in POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Fires: additionalProperties true → false

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, additionalProperties: true}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, additionalProperties: false}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Any additional property is no longer allowed in POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Does not fire: open schema removal

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {}, legacyId: {}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- A parent with unevaluatedProperties is reported by SCHEMA-900 instead.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-REQ-029
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-REQ-029: { severity: low }
```
